content.text: This matches the target closely enough. Exporting.

I built the manifold block and exported it to `submission.step`. The file is a single valid solid, and reading the STEP back gave the same volume and bounding box as the part.

All the dimensions are estimates I read off the composite images, so the proportions are close but not exact. I checked the part by rendering the same four camera views and comparing them with `composite.png`. The orientation and the main features line up, but I can't measure how close the voxel IoU will be.

**What the part has:**
- **Block:** 100 × 28 × 70 mm in X × Y × Z.
- **+Y face:** a slot 18 mm wide and 6 mm deep running the full height in Z, near the +X end. Inside it are three overlapping Ø8 mm channels, which make the scalloped walls seen in the renders. There are also two Ø6 mm blind holes, one near each end.
- **−Y face:** a 6 mm deep figure-8 pocket made of two overlapping circles (Ø26 and Ø20 mm) toward the −X end, plus two Ø6 mm blind holes toward the +X end.

**Guesses that most affect the score:**
- The depth of the pockets and holes can't be seen in the renders, so I picked them. I made all the small holes blind; if they actually go through the block, the IoU will be slightly off.
- The internal shape of the channel is simplified compared with the target, which shows small bumps between the channels.

My second round of fixes was first added on top of the original model instead of replacing it. I recreated the file and rebuilt it cleanly before exporting, so the submitted part doesn't include that mistake.

You can look at the part in the live viewer: http://127.0.0.1:8771/#part.FCStd
